shinydataviewer: Reusable Shiny data viewer components

Source: R/shinydataviewer-package.R
shinydataviewer-package.Rd

shinydataviewer provides a drop-in Shiny module for viewing tabular data with a summary sidebar and a reactable-based data viewer.

Details

The main exported entry points are:

  • data_viewer_ui()

  • data_viewer_card_ui()

  • data_viewer_server()

  • summarize_columns()

See the pkgdown articles for end-to-end examples:

  • vignette("get-started", package = "shinydataviewer")

  • vignette("customization", package = "shinydataviewer")
